text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After going out with Sakura Laurel,
we were about to head back through the park—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That person sleeping in the shade over there...
Could it be... Sky-chan?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmm... mumble mumble...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they look like they're sleeping so peacefully.
...Though if they stay like that, they might catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Sky-chan, wake up~.
It's already evening. Wanna head home together?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmph? Mnnn~~~...—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Zzz... snooore... zzz...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I thought she woke up for a second.
...Once she's like this, nothing can budge her, can it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hmm... In that case—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Nyaaao♪
choice_data_list: What's wrong, all of a sudden!?
What's wrong, all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that was my impression of the alarm Sky-chan always uses!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I figured that if it was the same kitty voice as your alarm,
you might actually wake up!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Nyaaago♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!
...Mmh, mmh~~~ ...mumble mumble.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, looks like they're starting to dream
of happy kitties~?
Just one more push!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Next, let's do a chorus just like a snooze alarm!
Trainer, you do the impression too, please♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Well then, here I go—
Nya nya nya nyaa~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel is dead serious.
I have to give a proper impression and live up to this...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! That sounded like an impression!
Let's keep up that momentum and go all out!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm, mmmmhh~~...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
This feels wonderful!
Trainer, please give me more~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, bwahaha! Ahahahahaha!
St-Stop it already~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Good morning, Sky-chan!
How are you feeling after waking up?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Geez! Now I'm totally wide awake! Jumping in halfway through like that is so unfair, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Huh? How did you know?
Even though I was fast asleep.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No, you definitely knew I was awake.
Yet you went and messed with me anyway~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: You figured it out? It was so hard for me to hold back my laughter too~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: See?! You were totally having fun doing impressions of the Trainer, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Aha, well, that kitty was way more
serious than I expected... so I couldn't help it♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"That was spot-on! Could you do it one
more time so I can learn the trick?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~! It's like the real thing!
...Ah, gotta record it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Look into the smartphone and do it one more time, ple~aseâª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept up in Sakura Laurel's pace,
I ended up doing tons of cat impressions!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I think so too!
I definitely want to hear it one more time!
Trainer, don't you agree?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'd like to hear it.
Yeah, I'd like to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I'm expecting a suuuuuper high-quality
impersonation from you, Laurel-sanâª"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Then we can't do a half-hearted impression!
Sky-chan, since you know all about cats,
would you show us an example first~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! That's how it's gonna be~...?
...Laurel-san is truly terrifying!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, whatever could you mean?
Come on, look look~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel gracefully dodged
Seiun Sky's attempt at payback!
